accuracy.anchor: All eight points stated with the file or number behind them (anchor: 27–30 = every point, sourced).

structure.anchor: Headline first in framing and update; outcome → evidence → next → risk → ask held, with risk placed after next action (anchor: 22–25 = order held, one minor swap).

customer_relevance.anchor: Yes/no on cross-brand access first, then 7 findings and 121 statements per page; ask is concrete (anchor: 18–20 = numbers in most sentences).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: Every segment within ±5 s; one filler in 10.8 spoken minutes, no long pauses (anchor: 13–15).

recovery.anchor: All three objections followed acknowledge → boundary → evidence → offer; the interruption got a number, not a hedge (anchor: 9–10).

stems: "Yes, we are leaking across brands — here is the one file." — keep the yes/no before the count.
"Risk: … Ask: …" — move the risk line before the next action next time so the ask lands last.
"After a month we compare…" — keep offering a measurable trial when a stakeholder defends an existing tool.
previous_run_comparison: Second run on the same transcript (stability check): total 92 vs run 1; only brevity_and_fluency moved, by -1 point.
